Kind regards,

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Plot of the final estimated genetic map
parts:
R/qtl can provide only simple views of genetic maps. For publication, I would generally modify them by hand with a lot of custom code.

You might look at alternate packages, such as LinkageMapView, https://cran.r-project.org/package=LinkageMapView

karl
